primaryFieldTooltip: Primary column: identifies each record. Cannot be deleted, moved or hidden.
maxLengthHint: Set the max text length; leave empty for no limit
regexHint: Use JavaScript regex syntax; empty means no validation
regexPresetHint: Click a tag to quickly fill common patterns
precisionHint: Set displayed decimal places for numbers, default 0
formulaHint: Reference other fields with {FieldName}; supports math, text, date and logic functions
prefixHint: Add a fixed prefix before the number
suffixHint: Add a fixed suffix after the number
digitLengthHint: Set digit length; pad with leading zeros when short (0 = no padding)
includeDateHint: Add a date prefix to the number when enabled
dateFormatHint: Choose the display format for the date prefix
allFileTypesHint: No selection means all file types allowed
maxFileCountHint: Max number of files allowed, default 20
thumbnailHint: Generates thumbnails for images and videos when enabled
selectTargetTableHint: Select the target table to link
selfLinkHint: Linking to itself can set record hierarchy in the table view
relationshipHint: One-to-One: each record links one target; One-to-Many: each record links multiple; Many-to-One: multiple records link one target; Many-to-Many: records link each other
selectDisplayField: Select the field shown in the link
selectDisplayFieldHint: Select the target field to show in the link; first field shown if empty
bidirectionalHint: Creates a reverse link field in the target table for viewing source records
defaultValueHint: Set the default value, auto-filled when creating records
cannotDragBeforePrimary: Cannot drag a field before the primary column
deleteFieldConfirm: Delete the field "{name}"? Its data will be unrecoverable.
